ai.overview: Dallas has defended the belt 3 times in this reign and enters on a 5-game winning streak, while Montréal has won their last 2 games and brings a storied belt history with 342 previous reigns.
key_matchups: Dallas' 5-game winning streak versus Montréal's 2-game run: the Stars have been dominant at home in this stretch
All-time head-to-head tilts heavily toward Montréal with 89 wins to Dallas' 50 across 160 meetings
Recent series has been competitive with three of the last five meetings decided by a single goal
ai.betting_angles: Dallas enters with a 7-4 record and momentum from 5 straight victories, including a 6–3 win over the Islanders in their most recent outing. Montréal sits at 6-5 and has won their last 2, though they dropped home ice to San Jose 3–4 earlier in the stretch. The Elo model favors Dallas as the home favorite.
ai.prediction_writeup: Dallas has won their last 5 games and defends the belt for the fourth time in this reign on home ice. While Montréal's all-time dominance in the series is notable with 89 wins to 50, recent form heavily favors the Stars. The Canadiens have been inconsistent this season at 6-5, and Dallas' 7-4 record reflects steadier play. With the Elo model backing the home side and Dallas riding excellent momentum, the Stars should retain the belt.
